summary: Connect an illustrative thorax motion to pressure direction and airflow phase labels.
objective: Create a breathing illustration with a diaphragm, lungs and airflow arrows tied to clearly labeled phases.
example_prompts: Create a breathing illustration with a diaphragm, lungs and airflow arrows tied to clearly labeled phases.
Pause inhalation and compare alveolar pressure with atmospheric pressure.

entities.name: Thorax frame
entities.guidance: Use a simplified rib envelope with a cutaway side and a diaphragm dome below two lung envelopes.

entities.name: Airway
entities.guidance: Keep tracheal tube connected to left and right branches with arrow paths inside the lumen.

entities.name: Pressure comparison
entities.guidance: Show atmospheric reference and qualitative alveolar pressure relation beside the scene.

object_craft.structure: Use a simplified rib envelope with a cutaway side and a diaphragm dome below two lung envelopes.
object_craft.material: Muted bone-like frame and translucent schematic lung surfaces.

object_craft.structure: Keep tracheal tube connected to left and right branches with arrow paths inside the lumen.
object_craft.material: Neutral airway walls and legible arrowheads.

object_craft.structure: Show atmospheric reference and qualitative alveolar pressure relation beside the scene.
object_craft.material: Flat high-contrast labels; no fabricated monitor trace.

state_contract.model: Authored sequence rest, inspiration, end-inspiration, expiration; relative pressure sign and flow direction are explicit phase values, not computed physiology.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Pause a phase and inspect arrows.

invariants: Airflow arrows point inward only when phase pressure is below atmospheric and outward only when above.
Zero-flow transition frames show equalized pressure rather than moving arrows.
Airways remain connected as lung envelopes change.
motion_guidance: Coordinate diaphragm lowering and thorax expansion during the authored inspiration pose.
Do not use a free sinusoid for arrows independent of the phase state.
known_limits: Qualitative quiet-breathing explanation; no pressure-volume calibration, gas exchange or disease model.
Geometry is schematic and not a patient-specific reconstruction.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.

claims.statement: Ventilation direction depends on the pressure difference between atmosphere and lungs; diaphragm and thoracic muscle movement contributes to the pressure changes.
claims.scope: Qualitative ventilation mechanism only; the authored phase timing is not sourced patient data.

source_refs.locator: Mechanisms of Breathing; Pressure Relationships; Physical Factors Affecting Ventilation

physical_contract.scope: Illustrative ventilation phases, no fluid solver.
driving: Shared phase sequence for deformation and arrows.
contact: No pleural or tissue contact mechanics.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Pressure sign and arrows agree at inspiration, expiration and zero-flow transitions.
